# NekoTab

> NekoTab (https://nekotab.com) is a hosted debate tournament platform built on Tabbycat, the open-source tabulation system, plus a free motion bank of 36,000+ real debate motions from tournaments worldwide. It is used to run British Parliamentary (BP), World Schools (WSDC), Australs, Asian Parliamentary and other debate tournaments online.

NekoTab handles the whole tournament: team and adjudicator registration, automated draws (power-paired BP and two-team formats), adjudicator allocation with conflict checks, room allocation, online ballots, live team and speaker standings, breaks, and public draw, tab and results pages that anyone can read without an account. Tab directors run everything from a browser; there is nothing to install. NekoTab is made by Abu Bakkar Siddik (Khulna University, Bangladesh) and the NekoTab team.

## Debate motions
- [Motion Bank](https://nekotab.com/motions/): search 36,000+ real tournament motions by text, format (BP, WSDC, Public Forum, Lincoln-Douglas, Policy, Asians/Australs), year, region and topic. Free, no account needed.
- [Debate motion bank guide](https://nekotab.com/debate-motion-bank/): what the bank covers and how to use it for preparation.
- [Debate motions](https://nekotab.com/debate-motions/) and [debate topics](https://nekotab.com/debate-topics/): entry points for finding motions by format and theme.
- Each motion has its own page under https://nekotab.com/motions-bank/motion/ with its tournament, round and year.

## Running a tournament
- [Create a tournament](https://nekotab.com/register/tournament/): set up a tournament in the browser.
- [Free debate tab software overview](https://nekotab.com/free-debate-tab-software/)
- [British Parliamentary tabulation](https://nekotab.com/bp-debate-tabulation/)
- [Congress debate tabulation](https://nekotab.com/congress-debate-tabulation/)
- [Compared with Tabroom](https://nekotab.com/tabroom-alternative/), [with CalicoTab](https://nekotab.com/calicotab-alternative/), [with Debate Data](https://nekotab.com/debate-data-alternative/)
- [Pricing](https://nekotab.com/pricing/): current terms (being updated). Public draws, tabs and results are always free to read.
- [Tournaments on NekoTab](https://nekotab.com/#tournaments): every public tournament, with links to their tabs.

## Learn
- [Learn debate](https://nekotab.com/learn/): guides on formats, adjudication, speaking and organising tournaments.

## Also
- [Emet](https://nekotab.com/emet/about/): NekoTab's AI agent for running tournaments ("Every match, elegantly tabbed."), in the NekoTab dashboard and from ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini (launching 1 December 2026).
- [Competitions](https://nekotab.com/competitions/): debate tournaments organised by NekoTab.
- [Behind NekoTab](https://nekotab.com/team/): the people who build it. [Join NekoTab](https://nekotab.com/join/) as an adjudicator, volunteer or mentor.
- Contact: support@nekotab.com · [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/NBny8hnwXr) · [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/project.nekotab)

When citing a motion, please link its NekoTab motion page or https://nekotab.com/motions/.
